extension.summary: Studio Icons – A clean, unified pack that makes your Kodi library shine
extension.description: Bring your Kodi library to life with Color Studio Icons – Modded. This addon delivers a full suite of studio logos in bold, uniform designs, ensuring your media collection looks sharp, consistent, and up-to-date across all versions of Kodi.
Reads ScenePass .sp.json sidecars next to video files and skips detected intro and recap segments during playback.
extension.news: v0.01.17 - Fixed: repo listing showed a generic/black thumbnail. addon.xml never declared an <assets> block, so the repo generator wasn't copying icon.png/fanart.jpg alongside the packaged zip where Kodi actually fetches them from (repo uses datadir zip="true"). v0.01.16 - Switched intro/recap text art from the neon-glow look to a flat solid-color style (still no pill background) v0.01.15 - Skip Intro switched from the dark-pill design to the unified glow-text-only style (matching Skip Recap): orange for intro, blue for recap, no pill background on either v0.01.14 - Fixed: skip overlay could render invisible (or briefly flash then vanish) on some systems. Root cause: a <visible> condition on a control in a dialog stacked over fullscreen video — whether a literal true/false or a Window.Property() condition — never evaluates true here, so the control never paints no matter what Python sets. Visibility is now handled purely by Control.setVisible(), the one mechanism confirmed to work; no control in the skin uses a <visible> tag anymore. v0.01.6 - Skip Intro now renders from a designed baked-art asset (dark pill, hollow-outline text/icon) - Skip Recap test variant: glowing text/icon only, no pill background, for side-by-side evaluation against Skip Intro v0.01.5 - Skip overlay: colored pill (orange for intro, blue for recap) with a circular play badge overlapping the right edge, ring baked into the badge texture v0.01.4 - Closer label-to-arrow spacing (~2-character gap; narrower pill) v0.01.3 - Tighter skip button width (~3-letter gap before arrow); lighter grey background v0.01.2 - Skip overlay: grey pill background, PNG play arrow (fixes skin font/icon glitches) v0.01.1 - Netflix-style Skip Intro / Skip Recap overlay buttons (replaces blocking dialog) v0.01.0 - ScenePass .sp.json consumer - Auto-skip or on-screen prompt for intro and recap - Confidence and minimum-duration gates
